approaches.name: Digital credentialing, assessment and career information platforms for students
approaches.description: Deploys blockchain micro-credentials, digital assessment and career information systems to certify competencies and guide student choices. Practices: Blockchain-backed micro-credentials for student employability skills; Classroom diagnostic tools with preventive early-warning protocol; National virtual learning platform with unified LMS and competency certification; Agile digital assessment platform with automated item bank; Blockchain-based micro-credentials for student competencies; Online information system on technical career rates of return; Digital formative assessment information system for classrooms; Career information digital platform for technical students; Digital micro-credentials for English proficiency certification; Digital career information platform for technical secondary students.

Indicator 4: Percentage of technical stream secondary education students with micro-credentials registering English proficiency (all these indicators will be disaggregated by gender and by indigenous and refugee/migrant status).

This component includes the following: (i) Diagnostic tools for the classroom that will provide a teacher with an accurate understanding of the level of literacy and numeracy of each student and of the classroom as a whole - the diagnostic will help the teacher understand objectively the need for learning recovery from school disruptions and other causes as well as a preventive early-warning protocol to help prevent students falling behind in the future;

This last activity would include the development of a national learning platform for virtual learning; implementation of a monitoring mechanism, such as the World Bank’s Education and Technology Readiness Index (ETRI); and development of digital resources such as e-books, multimedia contents, simulation exercises, and educational applications, as part of a unified learning management and competency certification system.
An “agile evaluation” learning assessment system will be implemented, providing flexibility with a variety of assessment methods (quizzes, tests, assignments) catering to different subjects.
(ii) a high-quality digital item bank to automatically generate competency-based formative and summative assessments;

(iii) development of a digital assessment platform whose data will feed into automated information system modules available at the central and regional levels; and (iv) training on the use and maintenance of the platform for end users.

Fourth, the subcomponent will include the development and deployment of a range of digital tools to support employability, including information systems to provide students with information on comparative rates of return in various technical careers and fields and the provision of blockchain-based micro-credentials for competencies, including digital competencies and soft skills.
